data.description: Wave 1 keystone, mechanical relocation with zero behavior change. SPEC IDs: DX-1..DX-5. Dispatch switch leaves TerminalController.swift for per-domain handler units; threading/focus policy preserved verbatim; baseline tests_v2 parity run recorded before and after. Deeper router redesign out of scope. Contract: docs/cycles/2026-07-truth-and-stability/ (SPEC.md, EVALUATION.md, BUILDPLAN.md). Validation bar: tagged build + recorded scenario proof.
data.title: Extract socket dispatch from TerminalController into per-domain handlers

data.body: Plan phase: studied dispatch architecture. v2 processV2Command 227 cases/20 domains; v1 processCommand 112 cases; off-main worker switches (socketWorkerV1/V2Response) must stay nonisolated. ~17k LOC handlers, browser ~4k (will split). Writing plan now.

Implement phase started. Working against origin/main @ 8a98f0f7e (fast-forwarded worktree onto it; origin was ahead only by web/ci dependabot bumps, none touching Sources/). TerminalController.swift = 20351 LOC at base. Recording tests_v2 baseline next.

MASTER VALIDATOR: source leak onto MAIN CHECKOUT. /Users/atin/Projects/Stage11/code/c11/Sources/TerminalController.swift is dirty (uncommitted, ~0m) with the C11-159 private->internal widening (V2HandleKind / V2SocketRequest / V2CallResult), but the main checkout HEAD is still run base b0f9120b2. This edit is NOT present on ts/dx-dispatcher-extraction @ a449c780b (all three types are still 'private' there). Implication: the DX delegator appears to have edited the main checkout working tree instead of its worktree (c11-worktrees/dx-dispatcher-extraction). Risks: (1) dirty main checkout can break the orchestrator's Wave 1 merge/checkout; (2) the widening may be missing from the DX branch itself -> non-compiling extraction if SocketHandlers/ reference the still-private types. Recommend: delegator re-apply the widening in its worktree and revert the main-checkout file to HEAD. (Master Validator audits only; not fixing.)

MASTER VALIDATOR [ESCALATION of prior tick finding]: DX work is now COMMITTED onto the main checkout's local 'main' branch, not the worktree. Local main HEAD = 5d7689da8 'C11-159: extract window.* socket handlers + dispatcher seam', one commit AHEAD of origin/main (f14cbc0fd). 'git branch --contains 5d7689da8' = main ONLY; it is NOT on ts/dx-dispatcher-extraction. The DX worktree branch (a449c780b) has only the DX-2 baseline-recording commit and is MISSING the extraction. Two consequences: (1) local main has diverged with un-gated DX work — any push/pull from the main checkout would either land DX on main outside the PR+parity gate or fail on divergence; (2) the DX PR, opened from ts/dx-dispatcher-extraction, would OMIT the window.* extraction. Recommended remediation (delegator/orchestrator, not MV): cherry-pick 5d7689da8 onto ts/dx-dispatcher-extraction in the worktree, then hard-reset the main checkout's main back to origin/main (f14cbc0fd). Master Validator audits only; not modifying git state.

ORCHESTRATOR: Master Validator's stray-commit finding remediated. 5d7689da8 cherry-picked onto ts/dx-dispatcher-extraction as b7e4364f3; WIP ThemeHandlers.swift moved to the worktree; main checkout reset to b0f9120b2 and verified clean (only .lattice live state remains modified, preserved untouched). Backup ref dx-stray-backup retained temporarily. Delegator unfrozen with corrected path discipline + pre-commit toplevel guard.

Implement progress: all 20 v2 domains extracted into Sources/SocketHandlers/ (window/workspace/surface/pane/browser[x2]/debug/theme/system+auth+app/snapshot/conversation/notification/markdown+feedback/misc[settings,sidebar,session,tab,mailbox]). v2 dispatch switch decomposed into per-domain slices via v2DispatchExtracted prefix router. TerminalController.swift 20351->9676 LOC (DX-4 met). c11-logic BUILD + full TEST suite GREEN. DX-3 threading preserved (nonisolated tiers intact, surface workers still off-main). Next: relocate v1 dispatch + shells to SocketDispatch.swift, then post-parity + PR.

Extraction COMPLETE + c11-logic build & full test suite GREEN. Static DX verification:
- DX-1: 0 dispatch switches remain in TerminalController.swift (v1 switch cmd, v2 switch method, worker switches all relocated to Sources/SocketHandlers/SocketDispatch.swift); 20 per-domain handler units under Sources/SocketHandlers/.
- DX-3: nonisolated declarations 208==208 (base==HEAD); DispatchQueue.main.sync 13==13. Threading tiers preserved verbatim; surface send/read workers still nonisolated (off-main).
- DX-4: TerminalController.swift 20351 -> 8774 LOC; largest handler file BrowserHandlers.swift 1942 LOC (both under targets).
- DX-5: 472 unique case-strings IDENTICAL base vs HEAD (no method/command renames, no additions/removals, no wire changes).
Next: code-review phase, then dx-post tests_v2 parity + PR.

COMPLETE — at pr_open, PR #317 (https://github.com/Stage-11-Agentics/c11/pull/317), MERGEABLE. STOPPING per contract; orchestrator merges.

SUMMARY: Mechanical socket-dispatcher extraction. TerminalController.swift 20351->8774 LOC. 227 v2 cases -> per-domain v2Dispatch<Domain> slices in 15 files under Sources/SocketHandlers/, delegated by v2DispatchExtracted prefix router. Whole dispatch layer (v1 processCommand switch, processV2Command, off-main socket workers, parser helpers) relocated to SocketDispatch.swift -> 0 dispatch switches remain in TerminalController.swift.

DX VERIFICATION (all PASS): DX-1 (0 switches in TC; per-domain units) / DX-2 (c11-logic full TEST SUCCEEDED; tests_v2 dispatch subset post==baseline, identical reason-types; Release build SUCCEEDED) / DX-3 (nonisolated 208==208, main.sync 13==13; surface workers still off-main) / DX-4 (TC 8774<10k; max handler 1942<3k) / DX-5 (472 case-strings identical, no renames/wire changes). Independent code-review: PASS, no Critical/Major.

DEVIATE-WITH-FLAG:
1. tests_v2 baseline used a host-safe dispatch-representative subset (single tagged instance, no prod-hostile per-test relaunch) since the VM runner pkills c11 and the c11-vm is unreachable from this host while the operator works; full suite is CI/VM territory. Parity asserted as identical same-env pass/fail set + reason-types before/after. (See PARITY-baseline / VALIDATION docs.)
2. v1 dispatch: relocated the v1 switch wholesale into SocketDispatch.swift (widening v1 handlers in place) rather than decomposing v1 into per-domain slices; DX-1's per-domain-unit examples are all v2 domains (done). v1 handlers stay in TC as internal.
3. code-review CLI returned empty-diff (worktree/base quirk after origin/main advanced); used independent reviewer-agent fallback per boot §5.4.
4. Pre-existing (non-regression) browser.wait hang against a no-page QA build; verbatim-relocated code, env-fails identically at baseline. Flagged, out of DX-5 scope.
5. origin/main advanced to 8dc966e42 (HYG/WEB landed) under the branch; my changes are disjoint (no file overlap), PR is MERGEABLE with a clean 23-file diff (no node_modules), no rebase needed.

Merged by orchestrator (PR #317, squash). Gates verified: DX-1..5 all PASS with static evidence (TerminalController 20351→8774 LOC; 20 v2 domain handler units; nonisolated 208==208; main.sync 13==13; 472 case-strings identical), tests_v2 parity baseline+post recorded (host-safe dispatch-representative subset — deviation accepted and logged; full suite is CI/VM territory), c11-logic full suite green, independent code review PASS, full CI green. v1 switch relocated wholesale (accepted scope call). Wave 2 unblocked.
